message.reasoning_content:
Confirmed: containers can't be added in place. So the Pod must be recreated with the same name and spec plus sidecar. There's no owner (e.g. Deployment) to update — the Pod is the persistent resource itself.

Create the new manifest explicitly, preserving all user-specified fields: labels, container web (command, image, port name http 8080), emptyDir shared, restartPolicy Always, dnsPolicy etc. (defaults are fine but I'll keep minimal + explicit).

Sidecar: name "page", busybox:1.37.0, writes index.html once then sleeps so it stays Running (restartPolicy Always). Use a long sleep with wait loop, e.g. `sleep 86400` — actually better `while true; do sleep 3600; done`.

Content: HTML page.

Do delete+create. Use `kubectl replace --force`? That deletes and creates from file — simpler and atomic-ish. But careful, replace --force does delete then recreate. I'll do explicit delete/create with a wait.

Also service: only `kubernetes` svc exists, no service for app, so verification through a Service isn't applicable. Verify with exec wget from inside the pod (curl through the pod IP). Also could check from another pod but exec into web is fine — that's the web server actually serving.
